title: Daily Signal Brief 012 — Quiet day; AI Act decision is T-2; FCC preemption trigger landed
summary: Quiet 24-hour signal window — three honest signals, no padding. Signal 1 (L3, fourth re-flag, last fresh elevation): EU AI Act Annex III high-risk consultation closes 2026-06-23 (T-13); the internal file/do-not-file decision deadline set yesterday at EOD Friday 2026-06-12 is now T-2. Helm + Forge + Compass have two operating days to land the Tier-3 call. Eglin will stop daily re-flagging after today; if no decision by Friday EOD, surface the lapse in Monday's weekly digest as a process-discipline observation rather than re-elevating. Signal 2 (L2): per the 2025-12-11 Trump executive order on federal AI policy, today (2026-06-09) is the 180-day deadline by which the FCC Chairman must initiate proceedings to adopt federal AI reporting/disclosure standards preempting state law. FCC docket not publicly noticed as of 14:02Z; authority is contested across Latham, Manatt, Womble, and Ropes & Gray briefs. Implication: over a multi-quarter horizon the state-law compliance-pressure arguments Compass uses (NYC AEDT $15K–$45K/month penalty stack, Colorado AI Act risk management, NY SHRM Act notice rules) erode at the margins — Compass should audit sales-enablement copy that ties buyer urgency to a specific state-law penalty rather than to Stratum's jurisdiction-strict posture (which survives any preemption outcome). Signal 3 (L2): PTD post-deadline state is quiet at T+3 days. Yesterday's four-state count (Italy + Slovakia + Lithuania full; Malta + Poland partial) holds across Littler, Bird & Bird, Trusaic, Synd.io, and L&E Global reconciliation; Commission letters of formal notice have not yet issued. Spain Work-Life Balance precedent suggests late-August window. Eglin downshifts PTD to weekly-digest cadence. Closed-loop note: Compass's PTD post-mortem was scheduled to ship EOD 6/9 with the four-state count — confirmation pending the artifact landing in /customers/ or /briefings/.
